items.title: 14Dimension Enterprise, 게임 전용 AI 게임마스터 내장 오프라인 TRPG '일루네스의 귀환(The Return of Illunes)' Steam 정식 출시
items.excerpt: The Return of Illunes launched on Steam (KRW 22,500 / $19.99) with a fine-tuned AI game master bundled on-device: it writes each run's story, companion dialogue, subclasses, skills, relics and bosses, and adjudicates free-text 'free actions' with no server, subscription or per-use fee; damage and stats stay rule-bound.

items.title: Arc Raiders is replacing AI with real human performances, starting with Celeste
items.excerpt: Embark is moving trader NPC Celeste off text-to-speech-driven performance to full motion and facial capture of voice actor Diana Gardner, debuting in the Frozen Trail trailer; the studio admits her limited expressiveness was immersion-breaking.

items.title: Arc Raiders publisher developing AI anti-cheat stack in escalating war with cheaters
items.excerpt: Embark is building an AI-based cheat-detection stack for Arc Raiders, paired with game-license blacklisting and permanent bans for first-time offenders.

items.title: [이슈] '사람 중심 축제'라더니...AGF, AI로 만든 티저 영상에 팬심 싸늘
items.excerpt: Korea's Anime x Game Festival (AGF 2026) posted an official teaser made with generative AI, two months before opening, drawing fan backlash; organizers had pledged a 'people-centered' festival at last year's press event.

items.title: AI 플루토, 놀라운 혁신인가 불공정한 체급 차이인가
items.excerpt: StarCraft: Brood War AI 'Pluto' is beating ex-pros and ASL players on YouTube with unconventional builds and perfect micro; Inven asks whether a machine with superhuman APM and vision is a fair competitor or just a new kind of training partner.

items.title: How Nordic studios are using AI part three: Lore checks, a "programmer's programmer" and the parts writers keep for themselves
items.excerpt: Four Nordic voices on where AI earns its place: Skábma studio Red Stage keeps gen-AI out of its games and Indigenous stories, using it only for producer 'dull bits', while others use it for lore checks and code assistance.

items.title: How developers are using AI right now
items.excerpt: Studio leaders describe how they are using AI across production, live ops and marketing.

items.title: Bloodborne PC port with full multiplayer can't get FromSoftware fans to vibe with vibe coding
items.excerpt: A Claude-assisted, vibe-coded Bloodborne PC port with full multiplayer is drawing rejection from FromSoftware fans who say they'll stick with the human-made emulator.

items.title: Ukranian modder slaps DLSS 5 onto Pac-Man with 4x Multipass
items.excerpt: A modder ran DLSS 5's neural rendering over Pac-Man in MAME via ReShade with 4x Multipass, producing creepy reinterpretations, including a mode that erases a ghost's eyes.

items.title: In the Hot Seat: Ex-Take-Two AI chief Luke Dicken on the $2tn bubble, junior jobs and the next 2008
